messages:
ava: Heads-up: new compact policy row in Compliance — region-first chips and an edit icon in the collapsed header. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/compact-policy (frame: compact-row). Quick pass on ordering, copy, a11y, and audit wording?

sam: +1 to region-first. Icon-only edit in collapsed state is fine, keep full CTA in expanded panel.

jordan: KMS label nit: never use "Managed" alone. Recommend explicit labels: "Redwood-managed (platform)" and "Customer-managed (BYOK)".

liz: Copy suggestion for chips: `eu-central-1` · `90 days` · `Customer-managed (BYOK)`. If region unset show `Region: Unselected` rather than "Global".

katie: a11y checklist: header action must be a native button with aria-label and aria-expanded. When the row expands announce a short aria-live="polite" summary (e.g., "Policy expanded: 90-day retention"). Ensure 44px tap target on mobile.

ava: Audit example (machine-readable) for infra:
2026-07-01T10:00:00Z policy.update actor=liz@example.com policy_id=pol_999 action=retention:update before=30d after=90d kms_owner=customer region=eu-central-1 source=console

jordan: And a human-friendly audit entry for UI: "Retention updated from 30 days to 90 days by liz@example.com (Key: Customer-managed (BYOK), Region: eu-central-1)". Keep it explicit for compliance reviewers.

liz: I'll open a copy PR. Helper text under encryption should read: "Key stored in customer's KMS; Redwood does not have key access." Avoid wording that implies we can decrypt customer data.

infra-bot: Ticket created: AUD-999 - add kms_owner and actor_email to audit schema and include human-friendly key_description.

ava: Thanks all 12 action items: liz=copy PR, jordan=prototype header icon + focus order, katie=a11y pass, infra=augment audit schema. Flag here if any copy still sounds like Redwood has key access. :thumbsup:
